summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Thrivent International Small Cap ETF (TISC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is an actively managed, small-cap focused, equity ETF. Stocks are selected from developed markets outside of the US using a multi-factor model TISC was launched on Jun 15, 2026 and is issued by Thrivent.
